title: Assert the main wallet only approved the trading agent
description: Web Terminal block: on the current wallet request window, assert the main wallet signed only ApproveAgent/ApproveBuilderFee typed data on its active chain, exactly approve_agent_count ApproveAgent, and never an L1 (agent) payload such as an order, cancel, edit, TP/SL or close.

signatures.intent: Prove the main wallet only approved the trading agent and never saw an order, cancel, edit, TP/SL or close payload

no_l1_proof.intent: Bind the proof to the recorded wallet window: no agent (L1) payload reached the main wallet

approve_agent_count.description: Exact number of ApproveAgent signatures expected in the window.
